messages.text: Morning all. Overnight recon run finished, but I'm seeing 14 breaks on the morning report vs 5 yesterday. Most look like settlement timing vs GL postings. Anyone else seeing that?
Yeah, I see it. Six of those are mine, T+1 equity trades that settled late yesterday. Looking at them now, probably just cutoff timing.
Two of the breaks are ACH items from the 4:30 batch. Totals are about $182k off between the payments side and GLCore. Not sure if that's real or a timing thing.
@Craig Garner can you send me the batch ids? I'll check whether GLCore posted them after the ReconLegacy snapshot was taken.
Question for @Priya Raman: did the ReconLegacy job start later than usual last night? The report timestamp reads 2:47 AM and I thought it normally kicks off at 1:30.

Morning. Checked the cron and the Perl wrapper. It kicked off on schedule at 1:30, but the Oracle 11g load step waited on a lock for about 70 minutes. That's why the timestamp is late and the snapshot was cut before the late GL postings.
That would explain my settlement breaks. Thanks Priya. Will they clear themselves on tonight's run?

Should, as long as the postings are in GLCore by cutoff. If you want them cleared sooner I can trigger a manual re-run of the match step this morning. It's about 20 min and doesn't touch the other jobs.
Yes please, a re-run would help. I'd like a clean report before the 10:30 ops sync.
Starting it now. I'll post here when it finishes.
Batch ids are in the thread on the break tickets. The two ACH items are both in the 4:30 file, so same cause I'd guess.
Re-run finished. Break count is down to 3. The remaining ones don't look like timing, so someone should check them manually.
Great, thanks. I see the 3 now. Two are amount mismatches on the payments side, so @Craig Garner, can you take those? The third is a Wayne item.
Got it, I'll pick up the third one and update the ticket by 10.
